confidence_notes: Food anchors use Cairo cost-of-living aggregates near the July 2026 window. Alcohol prices vary across licensed and tourist venues; cocktail and wine estimates use local beer pricing and available alcohol price cues. Lodging anchors are holistic estimates, not live listing checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; the food estimates are based on Cairo-specific aggregates, while accommodation is estimated for Cairo as a large tourism capital.
